manifest.help_text: Run manifest (required): a tab-separated .tsv with a header row and one data row per species. Exactly these columns: species (the species' ATB colour name, e.g. 'vibrio_cholerae'; used as the output-file prefix and folder name and as the target of the ATB cross-species check -- a species not in --atb_color_names skips that check with a warning, and its candidate markers pass through unchecked), metadata (path to the metadata table), assemblies (path to a directory of FASTAs or a .txt list of assembly paths -- detected automatically), target_groups (optional, comma-separated --group_label values to discover markers for; blank = every group with >= candidate_min_genome_count genomes, excluding 'unclassified'), atb_exclude_species (optional, comma-separated ATB colour names left out of the ATB check's max-outside test; 'unknown' is always excluded). See the README's Input section.

outdir.help_text: Directory where all results are published (one set per species in the manifest).

monochrome_logs.help_text: Should logs appear in plain ASCII

temp_space.help_text: Scratch/tmp storage (MB) requested from LSF via 'rusage[tmp=...]' for processes labelled request_temp (GGCAT, SBWT build, Themisto2 build). Raise for background-DB-scale runs.

marker_post_processing.help_text: Filter and soft-mask G (final candidate markers) for downstream assay design -- primer3 PCR primers and/or bait-capture tiling. Off by default -- the pipeline stops at the checked markers SBWT index/FASTA (markers_<species>_<group>/) unless this is turned on.

marker_min_length.help_text: Minimum candidate marker length in bp.

marker_gc_min.help_text: Minimum global GC%% a candidate marker's whole sequence must fall within.

marker_gc_max.help_text: Maximum global GC%% a candidate marker's whole sequence must fall within.

marker_window_size.help_text: Local sliding-window size (bp) for the non-designable-region GC check. Windows outside marker_gc_min-marker_gc_max are soft-masked (lowercased) in the output FASTA, not rejected -- primer3 runs with PRIMER_LOWERCASE_MASKING=1 so a primer's 3' end can't sit on a masked base but the rest of the candidate stays usable. Defaults to color_index_kmer_size (k-mer resolution).

marker_write_rejected.help_text: Write rejected (too-short / global-GC-out-of-range) candidates to their own FASTA.
